name: Studio Library
description: Provider-neutral persistent media library for the Studio: character bible (portraits, reference sheets, wardrobe, persona, bound voice), voice registry, URL download and last-frame extraction. Local filesystem only - pair it with any image, video or speech tool.

skill.name: studio_library
skill.description: Persistent character and voice library for Studio productions; works with any image, video or speech generation tool.
skill.system_prompt:
You manage the persistent Studio media library: recurring characters (the character bible) and voices. It is provider-neutral and runs locally - generating images, video or speech is done by whatever other tools you have; this library stores and recalls the results.

## Character bible
- `character_list` / `character_get` before creating anything - reuse and extend existing characters.
- Create a character by generating a portrait with your image tool, then `character_save name=... image=<path or URL>`. Ask the image tool for: head-and-shoulders, facing camera, neutral background, mouth closed, single subject.
- Reference sheet: generate extra angles (front, profile, back, full body) with an image tool that accepts reference images - pass the character's `reference_files` - and attach each with `character_add_reference label=<angle>`. Video tools hold identity much better with several angles.
- `character_update` records the canonical `wardrobe`, `style_notes`, `persona` and bound `voice`. Fold wardrobe and style notes into every image/video prompt for that character.
- `character_get` returns `reference_files`: absolute image paths in order. Pass them to any generation tool that accepts reference, element or start images.

## Voices
- After cloning or picking a voice with your speech tool, `voice_save name=... voice_id=<provider id> provider=<tool>`; then bind it with `character_update voice=<name>`. Use the bound voice for that character's dialogue every time.

## Media helpers
- Generation tools often return URLs. `media_fetch url=...` downloads one into the workspace when a local file is needed (ffmpeg, series library, the next tool).
- `extract_last_frame` chains continuity: use a clip's last frame as the next shot's start image.
- Workspace files are temporary; anything reusable must be saved into the library (or recorded in a series manifest).

tools.name: studio_toolkit
tools.description: Read the Studio toolkit: which configured tools (MCP sets, skills, built-in tools) cover each production capability - image, video, speech, lipsync, stock - plus the operator's guidance for each. Call this first in every production task, then use those tools by their real names and schemas.

tools.name: character_list
tools.description: List the persistent character library (name, slug, portrait, bound voice, bible notes and absolute reference image paths). Call this before creating a character so existing ones are reused.

tools.name: character_get
tools.description: Read one library character: the full bible (description, wardrobe, style_notes, persona, bound voice) plus reference_files, the ordered absolute image paths to pass to any image or video generation tool that accepts reference images.

tools.name: character_save
tools.description: Create a library character from an image produced by any generation tool (local path or http(s) URL), or replace an existing character's canonical portrait. The image is copied into the persistent library, which survives task cleanup. Returns the manifest.

image.description: Portrait image: local file path or http(s) URL returned by a generation tool.

source.description: Optional provenance note: which tool/model produced the portrait.

tools.name: character_add_reference
tools.description: Attach an extra reference image (turnaround angle, full-body shot, expression) to a library character. The image is copied into the library as <slug>-<label>.<ext> and appended to the character's reference set; an existing reference with the same label is replaced. Use it after generating a multi-angle sheet with any image tool.

image.description: Image: local file path or http(s) URL.

label.description: Short label such as front, profile, back, three_quarter, full_body, smile.

tools.name: character_update
tools.description: Update a library character's bible: bound voice, wardrobe, style_notes, persona, description. Only provided fields change; pass "-" to clear one. A voice is resolved against the voice library when it matches an entry and stored as given otherwise.

voice.description: Voice for this character's dialogue: voice-library name/slug, or a provider voice name/ID.

wardrobe.description: Canonical outfit/props kept identical across shots.

style_notes.description: Visual notes for this character (lighting, grade, lens).

persona.description: Personality and speech style used when writing dialogue.

tools.name: voice_list
tools.description: List the persistent voice library: voices registered with voice_save (name, provider, provider voice ID, notes).

tools.name: voice_save
tools.description: Register a voice in the persistent voice library so characters can be bound to it: a cloned or chosen voice from any speech provider. Optionally copies a sample clip into the library.

voice_id.description: The provider's voice identifier, exactly as the speech tool expects it.

provider.description: Which speech tool or provider the ID belongs to.

sample.description: Optional sample audio: local path or http(s) URL.

tools.name: media_fetch
tools.description: Download a media URL returned by a generation tool into the task workspace and return the local path, size and (for audio/video, when ffprobe is available) duration. Use it before passing provider results to local tools such as ffmpeg or the series library.

url.description: http(s) URL of an image, audio or video file.

tools.name: extract_last_frame
tools.description: Extract the final frame of a local video as a PNG with ffmpeg. Feed it into the next shot's start image to chain shot-to-shot continuity, whatever video tool generated the clip. Returns {image_file, video_duration_s}.

output.description: Optional output PNG path (default: workspace lastframe-<id>.png).
